dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: You can leave the trickier opponents to me.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: You did invite me here, after all, so I'll do my part for the cause, no problem.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: As for what part that'll be exactly, arrange that however you wish. I can handle it.
